name: dreamfab
description: Dreamfab 造夢廠, an AI media workstation on AutoIP: one sentence and you direct and produce. Short dramas (script, cast, each character's own voice, edit, subtitles, covers) and music videos (storyboard, lip-sync, beat-synced edit, kinetic lyrics, thumbnails), with one shared core for jobs, credits, GPU enhancement, the library and YouTube.

interface.shortDescription: AI short dramas and music videos, one sentence at a time
defaultPrompt: Use dreamfab-drama to turn script.md into a short drama
Use dreamfab-mv to turn song.mp3 into a music video
